name: Dark Phoenix Saga
description: Jean Grey succumbs to the limitless power of the Phoenix Force and becomes the Dark Phoenix, forcing the X-Men to confront betrayal, cosmic annihilation, and the question of whether one life is worth the survival of an entire universe.
flavorText: The fire rises. The Phoenix must be stopped—or the universe will burn.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Terror / Horror Sting. Jean Grey becoming the Dark Phoenix and cosmic annihilation. Screeching high strings and apocalyptic brass. Terrifying and tragic, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
